fit: caffeine from coffee and other sources in Parkinson progression cohorts
assessment: The two early Parkinson cohorts examined treatment initiation and UPDRS progression with aggregate caffeine exposure. They did not report individual fatigue outcomes or brewing information.

fit: added caffeine in instant decaffeinated coffee and measured attention in Parkinson disease
assessment: Twenty-four Parkinson participants completed the crossover. Both arms used instant decaf and one included an added caffeine tablet. The main report and S1–S6 give task findings without fatigue severity.

fit: pre-dose fatigue during withdrawal from habitual caffeine
assessment: Fatigue VAS on arrival was inconclusive across study conditions (p=.301). Ratings preceded the assigned dose at each visit. Supplements used flavored water in habitual users outside Parkinson disease.

fit: added caffeine in decaf and sustained motor endurance in healthy participants
assessment: Twenty-three healthy crossover completers had inconclusive motor endurance and force comparisons. Decaf coffee was in both arms and no subjective fatigue severity was measured.
